motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: Single authored entrance for screen arrival.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single obvious action in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brand, #38bdf8); color: var(--brand-ink, #04121a); padding: 10px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 13px/1.15 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.55); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #38bdf8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action with a quiet surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: var(--pill, #1a1a1a); color: var(--fg, #fafafa); padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(255,255,255,.09)); border-radius: 12px; font: 600 13px/1.15 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { filter: brightness(1.18); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #38bdf8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, #161719); color: var(--fg, #fafafa); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(255,255,255,.09)); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--pill, #1a1a1a); color: var(--fg, #fafafa); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(255,255,255,.09)); border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 12px; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(var(--brand-rgb, 56,189,248), .6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--brand-rgb, 56,189,248), .14); }

components.name: Accent Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--brand-soft, rgba(56,189,248,.14)); color: var(--brand-light, #7dd3fc); font: 600 11.5px/1 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Clipweave is an operator's tool, not a marketing page. The interface behaves like a dim editing suite: near-black surfaces, one cyan instrument light, dense but breathable panels, and controls that stay out of the footage. Every screen exists to keep the user's eye on the preview, the timeline, and the next decision.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black chrome with a single cyan accent, never a rainbow.
Side-by-side icon and heading in empty states — no stacked feature-card template.
Flat surfaces; neutral shadows only, never colored halos.
Compact 12–16px radii, 8px rhythm, 11px minimum functional text.
Motion is one authored page entrance, not scattered effects.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks the current action or live state. If everything is cyan, nothing is.

rules.name: The No Tiny Text Rule
rules.body: Functional text never drops below 11px; 10.5px was a drift, not a style.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black and offset. A colored glow means a lighting bug.

dos: Do use --brand and its derived tokens for every accent surface.
Do keep icon and heading side-by-side in empty states.
Do use text-wrap: pretty on paragraphs so no single word is stranded.
Do keep minimum functional text at 11px.
donts: Don't use colored glow shadows or zero-offset chromatic halos on dark surfaces.
Don't stack an icon tile above a heading as the page structure.
Don't introduce a second accent hue for decoration.
Don't animate layout properties for casual state changes.
